name: Sin Eater adds 5 charges to Torchlight (#2201)
contract: Sin Eater 680542 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 4 = SPELLMOD_CHARGES, base 4 die 1 -> +5, SpellClassMask[0] 0x80000. Torchlight 503662 is family 21 with SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80000, so the modifier applies to it. Its charge pool is the spell_proc row Charges = 5 in data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260907_15_witch_hunter_torchlight.sql, read by Aura::CalcMaxCharges, which passes it through ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CHARGES). The Description reads 'Increases the amount of next attacks that grant Flames of Sin through Torchlight by 5.' A control and a holder each cast Torchlight on their own dummy; the applied aura must hold 5 and 10 charges, and the native modifier query must give the same 5 -> 10. Whether the extra attacks then grant Flames of Sin is the existing Torchlight script's job and is not asserted here. MEASURED on slot 3: the control's Torchlight read 4 charges as soon as the aura was seen and the holder's 9 a moment later (10 minus the same one), so a charge is already spent by the cast's own hit (unverified mechanism); the scenario therefore compares the holder with the control after a settling wait instead of asserting the raw 5 and 10, which raced that first spend. The first run also lost the holder's cast once (aura absent for 3 s) while a rerun and a probe applied it, so each caster throws twice (a landed aura is simply refreshed, a missed throw is retried) before the aura and charge assertions; the cause of the lost throw was not identified.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control: the charge modifier leaves Torchlight's 5 charges
Sin Eater adds 5 charges to Torchlight
Let the first throws land and the global cooldown pass
Control throws again (a throw that missed is retried; a landed one is refreshed)
Let each Torchlight's first charge settle
Control's Torchlight holds at most its 5 charges and at least one
With Sin Eater Torchlight holds exactly 5 charges more than the control's
